preset.purpose: Eight bodies in one scene (the number a level must hold; decision multiplayer-readiness), each with its own seeded random input source, for 60 s: six live players that collide with one another and two ghosts that collide with no player. Zero engine errors and the fuzz zeros with eight bodies simulating. (It saves a frame strip, so its frame times are not budget evidence.)

tick_cost_ms.what: wall time of one tick's scripts: every body's move and the instruments watching them

definitions.stuck: has not left a 1 cm ball for 3 s (360 ticks) while input asked for movement on every one of those ticks
definitions.fall_through_world: below kill_plane_y, or the body's shape shrunk by 5 cm overlaps a static body
definitions.non_finite: NaN or infinity in position, velocity, yaw or pitch
